# `toolu herdr-app`

Show a worker in an already running Herdr App.

Owner: `plugins/toolu`.

## `toolu herdr-app`

```text
Show a worker in an already running Herdr App

Usage: toolu herdr-app [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  show  Focus an existing local or remote terminal
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json              Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
  -q, --quiet             Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>       The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>  Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help              Print help
```

## `toolu herdr-app show`

```text
Focus an existing local or remote terminal

Usage: toolu herdr-app show [OPTIONS] <terminal-address>

Arguments:
  <terminal-address>

Options:
      --json              Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
  -q, --quiet             Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>       The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>  Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help              Print help
```
